title: VDBE builder operation and owner-state representations

scope.rationale: The append builder requires these exact active-profile operation, P4, Vdbe, Parse, and connection state identities as one representation boundary. Only fields read or written by the fixed-operand append core are assigned.
excluded_responsibilities: VDBE fields not accessed by operation append
Parse and sqlite3 fields owned by compiler, execution, mutex, or allocator units
P4 ownership classes other than NOTUSED and INT32

external_source_responsibilities: Pinned ABI target and generated active-profile C layout probes
Public SQLITE_LIMIT_VDBE_OP category index; its runtime value and mutation belong to connection-limit behavior
dependencies.caller_closure: All direct storage identities used by vdbe-operation-append-core are included; allocator-internal sqlite3/Lookaside state belongs to the connection-allocation unit.

inputs: Pinned active profile and aarch64-linux-gnu layout probe
Canonical generated opcode enum with u8 storage
outputs: ABI-exact Zig VdbeOp/P4Union/Vdbe/Parse/Sqlite3 storage for append state
Exact P4_NOTUSED, P4_INT32, and VDBE_INIT_STATE values
contracts.ownership: Representation-only unit; it introduces no allocations or destruction. Pointer optionality models C nullability without changing layout.
contracts.state_and_results: Field signedness, widths, offsets, union overlay, and constants match the active C preprocessor and layout oracle exactly.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Compile-time layout mismatch is a build failure; there is no runtime partial state.

representation_differences: C typedef and tagged-struct identities may converge on one Zig extern struct declaration.
The cycle-breaking Parse module uses opaque sqlite3/Vdbe pointers while retaining exact pointer layout; vdbeaux converts them only at the typed boundary.
C opcode integer storage is represented by enum(u8), preserving byte layout while making invalid values structurally unavailable to builder callers.

oracle.protocol: Generated C probes emit sizes, alignments, every relevant field offset/size, union member offsets, bit masks, and active constants; Zig compile-time checks and the VDBE builder differential consume those facts.
internal_observations: operation bytes emitted by the append builder
oracle.normalization: No layout normalization. Names are mapped explicitly; all numeric layout and constant observations are exact.

assurance.malformed_input: Generated enum prevents invalid builder opcode input; raw execution validation is a separate unit.
assurance.performance: Extern structs and enum(u8) add no translation or allocation layer.

integration.native_call_path: The source-corresponding vdbe_aux builder candidate uses these representations directly; the bounded handwritten production compiler is not yet migrated.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Duplicate handwritten Program/Instruction representations remain frozen and are outside this representation unit.

independent_review.notes: Independent review must verify scope closure, generated C facts, target ABI, and absence of semantic credit for unused fields.

known_blockers: Subsystem integration waits for the source builder/compiler path to replace handwritten Program construction.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbe.h was reviewed in full; selected lines 27 and 55-130 cover Vdbe/VdbeOp/P4 storage and NOTUSED/INT32 ownership classes under the active feature profile
upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeInt.h:458-538 was reviewed through the complete Vdbe structure and state constants; selected builder fields are db/pParse/aOp/nOp/nOpAlloc/eVdbeState
upstream/sqlite/src/sqliteInt.h:1350-1370, 1660-1710, and 3870-3930 were reviewed for Parse/sqlite3 identities and db/mallocFailed/aLimit/szOpAlloc fields
src/core/internal/vdbe_types.zig and parse_types.zig exact AST declarations are checked against generated/internal VDBE and Parse layout manifests
callers: vdbeaux.c:22-48 sqlite3VdbeCreate relies on zeroing from aOp onward, db/pParse linkage, INIT state, nOpAlloc, and Parse.szOpAlloc
vdbeaux.c:154-200 growOpArray reads/writes pParse, db.aLimit[SQLITE_LIMIT_VDBE_OP], aOp, nOpAlloc, and szOpAlloc while preserving the old array on OOM
vdbeaux.c:224-351 growOp3, addOp4IntSlow, sqlite3VdbeAddOp3, and sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int consume every selected VdbeOp field plus P4_NOTUSED/P4_INT32 and mallocFailed
The same layouts are consumed throughout VDBE execution/destruction, but fields outside fixed-operand append are explicitly excluded and owned by follow-on atomic units

The native source-corresponding vdbe_aux builder imports these exact extern representations; the handwritten Program/Instruction path remains a frozen competing architecture and receives no integration credit
callees: Representation declarations have no runtime callees; VdbeOp union overlay and field widths are consumed directly by builder code
Generated opcode identity supplies u8 opcode values, and generated layout probes supply size/alignment/offset facts; those artifacts are external immutable inputs
P4_NOTUSED and P4_INT32 are non-owning classes, so this unit introduces no destructor or allocation responsibility
assertions_branches_cleanup: The unit has no behavioral blocks because it is representation-only; active feature predicates omit explain comments, cursor hints, scanstatus/profile counters, coverage fields, normalize fields, and debug-only state
Critical invariants are opcode:u8, p4type:signed byte, p5:u16, p1/p2/p3:int, P4 union overlay, VDBE_INIT_STATE=0, P4_NOTUSED=0, and P4_INT32=-3
sqlite3 mallocFailed is u8, aLimit is SQLITE_N_LIMIT signed ints, and Parse.szOpAlloc plus Vdbe.nOp/nOpAlloc are signed ints used in overflow/OOM paths
No runtime allocation, branch, lock, callback, I/O, cleanup, or continuation occurs inside declarations; those obligations belong to builder/allocation/destruction units
upstream_tests: Upstream VDBE tests consume these layouts indirectly through every prepared statement; vdbe*.test and opcode-related suites exercise operation encoding and state transitions
Upstream malloc/mallocA fault suites exercise builder growth and mallocFailed continuation that depend on these fields without making representation itself a runtime owner
generated/internal/vdbe-layout.json and parse-layout.json are exact C layout probe results for the pinned target; internal-vdbe-layout-test and internal-parse-layout-test compare Zig declarations
vdbe-builder-differential compares emitted operation bytes; it remains separate behavioral evidence and is not a durable receipt for this context-only promotion
